choice_basis: Applicant counts only. Deer: 1st-choice applicants by preference-point value (CDFW "Total 1st Choice Applicants"); elk: all applicants for the hunt by point value as published ("Total Applicants"). Point values are party-averaged: elk x.5 rows are 2-person parties averaging a half point, and deer "N > N-1" columns (parties whose average falls between two whole numbers) are stored as N-0.5. The CDFW files do NOT report tags drawn per point level, so every drawn value is null. q.all = total tag quota, q.pref = preference-point quota (drawn top-down by points), q.rand = random-draw quota (all 1st-choice applicants not drawn in the preference portion).
